methods.name: canChangeEmergencyStop
methods.description: Returns if the emergency stop state can be changed using setEmergencyStop.

methods.name: canSetBlockSystemMode

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: See E_BLOCK_SYSTEM_MODE_ constants for possible values.

methods.description: Checks if the block system mode can be changed to a desired mode.
methods.returnDescription: True when it is possible to change the mode to the desired mode.

methods.name: findNearestTrack

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Range of sphere (in meters) to search a track within. When negative or zero, no range test will be performed.

methods.description: Searches for the nearest track of this coaster within a specified range.
methods.returnDescription: A TrackPos object that represents the track and position, or null if no track is within range.

methods.name: findNearestTrain
methods.description: Returns the nearest train at pos within range.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Returns a block with a specific name.

methods.name: getBlockSystemMode
methods.description: Returns the current block system mode the coaster is working in.
methods.returnDescription: See E_BLOCK_SYSTEM_MODE_ constants for possible returned values.

methods.name: getCoasterStyleId
methods.description: Returns the coaster style's type number.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the coaster's name.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns a section with a specific name.

methods.name: getSpecialTrack
methods.description: Returns a handle to a special track with a specific name.

methods.name: getTrackTrigger

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of track trigger as specified in the editor.

methods.description: Gets a track trigger by name.

methods.name: getTrackTriggers

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of track trigger as specified in the editor.

methods.description: Gets all track triggers having the same name.
methods.returnDescription: Array of TrackTrigger handles, or null if there is no track trigger with that name.

methods.name: getTrainAt

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Train index; must be in the range 0...getTrainCount()-1.

methods.description: Returns a handle to a train.

methods.name: getTrainCount
methods.description: Returns the number of trains.

methods.name: isEmergencyStop
methods.description: Returns the state of the emergency stop.

methods.name: isScriptedOperationMode
methods.description: Returns true when the coaster is in scripted operation mode.

methods.name: requestReset
methods.description: Requests resetting the coaster.

methods.name: setBlockSystemController
methods.description: Sets the block system controller, which is required for coasters that are in scripted operation mode.

methods.name: setBlockSystemMode

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: See E_BLOCK_SYSTEM_MODE_ constants for possible values.

methods.description: Sets the current block system mode the coaster should be working in.
methods.returnDescription: True when the mode was changed successfully, false if it could not be changed or if the mode parameter is invalid.

methods.name: setEmergencyStop

parameters.name: estop
parameters.description: True to enable, false to disable.

methods.description: Sets the state of the emergency stop.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the coaster's name.
